title: Holiday Bollywood Karaoke Party + Indian Dinner Buffet + BYOB
description: Celebrate the holidays with Bollywood karaoke, an Indian dinner buffet, festive vibes and BYOB at Indian Grill in Montgomeryville!
long_description:
Celebrate the holidays with Bollywood karaoke, an Indian dinner buffet, festive vibes and BYOB at Indian Grill in Montgomeryville!

About this Event

PHL Bollywood Karaoke Club Presents: Holiday Bollywood Karaoke PartyGet ready for a festive evening filled with Bollywood music, delicious Indian food, karaoke, and great company!
Join PHL Bollywood Karaoke Club for a Holiday Bollywood Karaoke Party at Indian Grill in Montgomeryville, Pennsylvania. Whether you love singing your favourite Bollywood hits or simply enjoy listening to music and spending time with friends, this event is a chance to celebrate the holiday season with the local community.
Enjoy a full Indian dinner buffet, take your turn at the microphone, or sit back and enjoy the music and festive atmosphere. Bring your friends, meet fellow Bollywood music lovers, and make it a memorable holiday outing!

Event DetailsDate: Sunday, December 13, 2026Time: 4:00 PM–9:00 PM ESTDoors Open: 4:00 PMVenue: Indian Grill, Montgomeryville, PennsylvaniaParking: Free parking availableAge Requirement: 21+
Ticket OptionsSinger Ticket — $45 per person
Includes the full Indian dinner buffet.Allows you to perform up to two songs during the event.Non-Singer Ticket — $40 per person
Includes the full Indian dinner buffet.Perfect for guests who want to enjoy the food, music, and company without performing.BYOB: Guests are welcome to bring their own beverages.

What to ExpectBollywood karaoke and favourite Hindi songsDJ-managed song queueUp to two songs per singerFull Indian dinner buffet included with every ticketA festive, welcoming atmosphere for Bollywood music loversAn opportunity to meet and connect with the local community
Karaoke GuidelinesEach singer may perform a maximum of two songs.Each ticket holder must sing for themselves; tickets cannot be used to sing on behalf of another attendee.If you do not plan to sing, please select the Non-Singer Ticket.Song requests will be managed through the event's DJ-managed song queue.
